title: Transformer-Based Flow Shop Scheduling Using MILP-Generated Training Data
abstract: arXiv:2608.29690v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Advances in machine learning (ML) have created new opportunities to complement traditional operations research (OR) methods. In particular, transformer models can capture complex interactions in token sequences by mapping tokens into a high-dimensional embedding space and propagating contextual information via attention. This makes them a candidate to model non-permutation flow shop scheduling with secondary resources as a next-token prediction task, where tokens represent job-machine-secondary resource tuples. For training, mixed-integer linear programming (MILP)-generated schedules are tokenized and used as next-token prediction data. During inference, partial token sequences (prefixes) are randomly generated and completed by the trained transformer through constrained decoding. translated_title: 基于Transformer的流水车间调度：使用MILP生成的训练数据
translated_abstract: 机器学习的进展为补充传统运筹学方法创造了新的机会。特别是，Transformer模型能够通过将token映射到高维嵌入空间并借助注意力机制传播上下文信息，从而捕获token序列中的复杂交互。这使得Transformer有望将带次要资源的非排列流水车间调度问题建模为下一token预测任务，其中token表示“作业-机器-次要资源”元组。在训练阶段，由混合整数线性规划（MILP）生成的调度方案被标记化，并用作下一token预测的训练数据。在推理阶段，随机生成部分token序列（前缀），并由训练好的Transformer通过约束解码进行补全。研究在一个包含8个作业、4台机器和3种次要资源的流水车间上开展了计算实验，其中作业从包含20个作业的固定作业池中选取……
tldr: 该论文提出将带次要资源的非排列流水车间调度问题建模为下一token预测任务，利用MILP生成的调度数据训练Transformer模型，并通过约束解码补全部分调度序列，从而将机器学习与传统运筹学方法相结合来解决调度问题。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates non-permutation flow shop scheduling with secondary resources as a next-token prediction task, training a transformer on MILP-generated schedules and completing partial token sequences through constrained decoding, thereby combining machine learning with traditional operations research methods.
